VLD_VL_VDH_VALIDATION_HEADER h
        INNER JOIN (SELECT

                      BT.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE,
                      BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AS DDL__PBETBUSENTITYTYPE,
                      COALESCE(MT.EPP1_DESC, BT.EPP1_DESC) DESCRIPTION,

                      BT.PORG_ORGACODE,
                      MT.PLNG_LANGCODE
                    FROM SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 BT LEFT JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1_M MT
                        ON BT.PORG_ORGACODE = MT.PORG_ORGACODE AND BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = MT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND
                           BT.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = MT.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                    WHERE BT.EPP1_ACTIVE IN ('Y', 'A') AND BT.EPP1_LEVELTYPE = 'D'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT

                      BT.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE,
                      BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AS "DDL__PBETBUSENTITYTYPE",
                      COALESCE(MT.EPP2_DESC, BT.EPP2_DESC) DESCRIPTION,

                      BT.PORG_ORGACODE,
                      MT.PLNG_LANGCODE
                    FROM SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 BT LEFT JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M MT
                        ON BT.PORG_ORGACODE = MT.PORG_ORGACODE AND BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = MT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                           AND BT.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = MT.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE
                    WHERE BT.EPP2_ACTIVE IN ('Y', 'A') AND BT.EPP2_LEVELTYPE = 'D'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT

                      BT.EPL1_BUSENT_LOG_LVL1_CODE,
                      BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AS "DDL__PBETBUSENTITYTYPE",
                      COALESCE(MT.EPL1_DESC, BT.EPL1_DESC) DESCRIPTION,

                      BT.PORG_ORGACODE,
                      MT.PLNG_LANGCODE
                    FROM SND_EN_PL1_PRF_BSEN_LOG_LVL1 BT LEFT JOIN SND_EN_PL1_PRF_BSEN_LOG_LVL1_M MT
                        ON BT.PORG_ORGACODE = MT.PORG_ORGACODE AND BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = MT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                           AND BT.EPL1_BUSENT_LOG_LVL1_CODE = MT.EPL1_BUSENT_LOG_LVL1_CODE
                    WHERE BT.EPL1_ACTIVE IN ('Y', 'A') AND BT.EPL1_LEVELTYPE = 'D'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT

                      BT.PORP_PRINCODE AS EPL1_BUSENT_LOG_LVL1_CODE,
                      'PRIN'           AS "DDL__PBETBUSENTITYTYPE",
                      COALESCE(MT.PORP_DESC, BT.PORP_DESC) DESCRIPTION,

                      BT.PORG_ORGACODE,
                      MT.PLNG_LANGCODE
                    FROM GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL BT LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL_M MT
                        ON BT.PORG_ORGACODE = MT.PORG_ORGACODE AND BT.PORP_PRINCODE = MT.PORP_PRINCODE
                    WHERE BT.PORP_ACTIVE IN ('Y', 'A') AND BT.PORP_LEVELTYPE = 'D') c
          ON h.PORG_ORGACODE = c.PORG_ORGACODE AND c.DDL__PBETBUSENTITYTYPE = h.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
             AND c.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = h.VVDH_BUSENTITY_CODE

         INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE PDOT
                    ON TSTM.PORG_ORGACODE = PDOT.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND TSTM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = PDOT.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 WRHFR

         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 WRHTO
